children.title: Cycle 39 · Interpretation of Inconclusive Preference Divergence

detail.title: Interpretation of Inconclusive Preference Divergence
detail.summary: Analysis of experiment exp-mem-pref-09 indicates that policy divergence in memory-augmented agents (0.16) remains below the predicted 0.20 threshold, failing to support the hypothesis of path-dependent preference formation in the current gridworld configuration. Further testing will investigate whether increased environment complexity or alternative reward structures trigger stronger divergence.
